## Context

One paragraph. When does this journey happen? Where is the user? What
else competes for their attention?

## Goal

What the user is trying to accomplish.

## Journey map

| Step | User action | User thought | User emotion | App response | Friction / opportunity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Opens app | "Let's get going" | Focused | Home screen | — |
| 2 | Picks program | "Is this the right one?" | Uncertain | Program detail | Add social proof? |
| 3 | Starts session | "Go" | Committed | Timer starts | Haptic on start |
| 4 | Logs set | "Done" | Engaged | Set appears in history | Set confirmation sound |
| 5 | Pause | "Call" | Interrupted | Timer pauses | Resume prompt |
| 6 | Resume | "OK back" | Re-engaged | Timer resumes from pause | — |
| 7 | Complete | "Yes" | Satisfied | Summary + streak | Share moment? |

## Friction themes

1. Program discovery uncertainty at step 2
2. Interruption recovery needs clearer state

## Opportunities

1. Social proof on program detail
2. "Pick up where you left off" banner on home
3. Live Activity during session
